Executive Order 11233  
ADLAI E. STEVENSON
A s a mark o f respect to the memory o f A d lai E . Stevenson, it is 
hereby ordered, pursuant to the provisions o f Section 4 o f Procla­
m ation 3044 o f March 1, 1954, that until interm ent the flag o f the  
U nited States shall be flown at h alf-staff on a ll buildings, grounds and 
naval vessels o f the Federal Government in  the D istrict o f Columbia 
and throughout the U nited States and its Territories and possessions.  
I  also direct that the flag shall be flown at half-staff for the same length  
o f tim e at all U nited States embassies, legations, consular offices, and 
other fa cilities abroad, including all m ilitary fa cilities and naval  
vessels and stations.
